total_model.summary: Model projects 52.5 total points (DAL 30, ARI 22). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 2.2), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 2.0), Combined defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
